# Open Computing Facility (OCF)

> > UC Berkeley's student-run computing organization providing free hosting, mirrors, and lab services

The Open Computing Facility is a student-run organization at UC Berkeley offering free computing resources including web hosting, shell accounts, mirror servers for Linux distributions and open-source software, and physical computer lab access. OCF maintains infrastructure supporting the campus community with services like Jenkins CI/CD, collaborative documentation, and system status monitoring.

## Key Topics

- Open Computing Facility (OCF)

## Documentation & Resources

- [Documentation – Open Computing Facility](https://wiki.ocf.berkeley.edu/): OCF documentation hub for UC Berkeley student computing and lab services

## Core Services

- [OCF Mirrors](https://mirrors.ocf.berkeley.edu/): OCF mirror server hosting Linux distros and open-source software packages
- [HedgeDoc - Collaborative markdown notes](https://notes.ocf.berkeley.edu/): HedgeDoc collaborative markdown editor for real-time note-taking at OCF

## System Status & Monitoring

- [Open Computing Facility Status](https://status.ocf.berkeley.edu/): OCF service status page tracking outages and infrastructure maintenance

## Optional
